sources.title: MolmoAct2: Action Reasoning Models for Real-world Deployment
sources.snippet: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to provide a single generalist controller for robots, but today's systems fall short on the criteria that matter for real-world deployment. Frontier models are closed, open-weight alternatives are tied to expensive hardware, reasoning-augmented policies pay prohibitive latency for their grounding, and fine-tuned success rates remain below the threshold ...

sources.title: MolmoAct2 Action Reasoning Models for Real-World Deployment
sources.snippet: We present MolmoAct2, a fully open action reasoning model built for practical deployment, advancing its predecessor, MolmoAct along five axes. We introduce Molmo2-ER, a VLM backbone specialized for spatial and embodied reasoning, trained on a 3.3M-sample corpus with a specialize-then-rehearse recipe.
